mapper.sql:
SELECT 'COURSE_REVIEW' AS tab, r.id, r.course_id AS objectId, c.course_name AS objectName, r.round_no AS roundNo, r.bound_version_no AS boundVersion, r.review_date AS occurredOn, r.review_result AS result, NULL::text AS secondaryResult, NULL::boolean AS inconsistent, NULL::text AS feedbackAvgScore, r.review_opinion AS opinion, r.record_state AS recordState, r.created_by AS operator, NULL::text AS outlet, NULL::text AS acceptorName, r.created_at AS createdAt FROM dtl_course_review r JOIN biz_course c ON c.id = r.course_id AND c.deleted = FALSE WHERE r.deleted = FALSE
UNION ALL
SELECT 'COURSE_TRIAL', t.id, t.course_id, c.course_name, t.round_no, NULL, t.trial_date, t.course_conclusion, t.lecturer_conclusion, t.inconsistent, (SELECT ROUND(AVG(f.score)::numeric, 1)::text FROM dtl_trial_feedback f WHERE f.trial_id = t.id AND f.deleted = FALSE), t.expert_opinion, t.record_state, t.created_by, NULL, NULL, t.created_at FROM dtl_course_trial t JOIN biz_course c ON c.id = t.course_id AND c.deleted = FALSE WHERE t.deleted = FALSE
UNION ALL
SELECT 'DEMAND_REVIEW', r.id, r.demand_id, d.demand_name, r.round_no, NULL, r.review_date, r.review_conclusion, NULL, NULL, NULL, r.review_opinion, '已完成', r.created_by, d.outlet, NULL, r.created_at FROM dtl_demand_review r JOIN biz_demand d ON d.id = r.demand_id AND d.deleted = FALSE WHERE r.deleted = FALSE
UNION ALL
SELECT 'DEMAND_ACCEPTANCE', a.id, a.demand_id, d.demand_name, a.round_no, NULL, CAST(a.accepted_at AS date), a.acceptance_result, NULL, NULL, NULL, a.acceptance_opinion, '已完成', a.created_by, NULL, a.acceptor_name, a.created_at FROM dtl_demand_acceptance a JOIN biz_demand d ON d.id = a.demand_id AND d.deleted = FALSE WHERE a.deleted = FALSE
UNION ALL
SELECT 'CASE_AUDIT', k.id, k.id, k.case_name, NULL, NULL, CAST(k.reviewed_at AS date), k.review_result, NULL, NULL, NULL, k.review_opinion, '已完成', k.reviewer_no, NULL, NULL, k.updated_at FROM biz_case k WHERE k.deleted = FALSE AND k.review_result IS NOT NULL

SELECT 'PENDING' AS tab, r.id, r.course_id AS objectId, c.course_name AS objectName, r.round_no AS roundNo, r.bound_version_no AS boundVersion, r.review_date AS occurredOn, r.review_result AS result, NULL::text AS secondaryResult, NULL::boolean AS inconsistent, NULL::text AS feedbackAvgScore, r.review_opinion AS opinion, r.record_state AS recordState, r.created_by AS operator, NULL::text AS outlet, NULL::text AS acceptorName, r.created_at AS createdAt FROM dtl_course_review r JOIN biz_course c ON c.id = r.course_id AND c.deleted = FALSE WHERE r.deleted = FALSE AND r.record_state = '待录入结论'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'PENDING', t.id, t.course_id, c.course_name, t.round_no, NULL, t.trial_date, t.course_conclusion, t.lecturer_conclusion, t.inconsistent, NULL, t.expert_opinion, t.record_state, t.created_by, NULL, NULL, t.created_at FROM dtl_course_trial t JOIN biz_course c ON c.id = t.course_id AND c.deleted = FALSE WHERE t.deleted = FALSE AND t.record_state = '待录入结论'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'PENDING', d.id, d.id, d.demand_name, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, '待验收', d.owner_no, d.outlet, NULL, d.updated_at FROM biz_demand d WHERE d.deleted = FALSE AND d.acceptance_state = '待验收'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'PENDING', k.id, k.id, k.case_name, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, '待审核', k.owner_no, NULL, NULL, k.updated_at FROM biz_case k WHERE k.deleted = FALSE AND k.case_state = '待审核' AND k.review_result IS NULL

sql.if: AND (objectName ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') OR operator ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%'))

mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dtl_course_review r WHERE r.deleted = FALSE AND date_trunc('month', COALESCE(r.review_date::timestamptz, r.created_at)) = date_trunc('month', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ) AS courseReviewMonth, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dtl_course_trial t WHERE t.deleted = FALSE AND date_trunc('month', COALESCE(t.trial_date::timestamptz, t.created_at)) = date_trunc('month', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ) AS trialMonth, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dtl_demand_review r WHERE r.deleted = FALSE) AS demandReviewTotal, ( (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dtl_course_review r WHERE r.deleted = FALSE AND r.record_state = '待录入结论') + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dtl_course_trial t WHERE t.deleted = FALSE AND t.record_state = '待录入结论') + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM biz_demand d WHERE d.deleted = FALSE AND d.acceptance_state = '待验收') + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM biz_case k WHERE k.deleted = FALSE AND k.case_state = '待审核' AND k.review_result IS NULL) ) AS pendingTotal
